sections.overall: The AEW PPV form this year has been beyond insane! Another 9+ rated show, putting it amongst the very best of the year, and of all time. The 2026 PPV average has been higher than any other year in AEW history! See the "Shows" page to compare and analyse more! Best match of the week was the Texas Death Trios title match of Brodido & Page vs New Level & Strickland (9.28). Bloody, violent, creative?words alone do not do it justice! A must-watch for hardcore wrestling fans. Both teams enter "Gold" status for the first time too.
sections.mens: Ilja Dragunov vs Tommaso Ciampa (8.85) was the best men's match of the week, eclipsing the main event between Ospreay and Fletcher. Not to be overlooked is Ciampa's double duty in his match against Mike Bailey - a great TV match! See the "Championships" page to see how well-ranked the National Title is after the most recent matches.
sections.womens: What a Women's World Title match featuring Mercedes Mone vs Marina Shafir (8.21)! The latter's best singles match by far and a gutsy, emotional performance from both women. Queen Aminata defended her TBS Title on Collision, though there were only small rating changes to all involved.
sections.menstag: The Young Bucks vs Davis & Doyle (8.22) was a brilliant clash of styles and just the latest in the Bucks' recent top match form. Meanwhile, The Motor City Machine Guns vs FTR (8.19) on Dynamite was the best bout in their series. MCMG have made a modest gain during this Best of 5 Series. Also points gained by two teams from The Cut from the excellent Anarchy in the Arena match. Glorious chaos all round!
sections.womenstag: Although it was a surprise title win, The Brawling Birds vs Wrathlander (5.76) was a let down. Hopefully the new champions can strive for the heights the last champions reached in their feud against Divine Dominion.
sections.trios: As well as the epic title match, we had teams represented by both The Conglomeration and Death Riders, as part of the afore-mentioned Anarchy in the Arena match.
